game.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered

roadmap.title: Escape the prison
roadmap.description: Finish the opening escape. Keep separate manual saves throughout the run and avoid console commands, which can disable achievements.

roadmap.title: Climb the Arena ranks
roadmap.description: Join Owyn's team and finish the Arena. Keep the issued raiment equipped during regular matches and save before each fight.

roadmap.title: Finish the Fighters Guild
roadmap.description: Take contracts in Anvil, Cheydinhal and Chorrol. Turn in your work and ask about Advancement after each contract batch. Save before assignments; reload if you lose guild membership.

roadmap.title: Finish the Mages Guild
roadmap.description: Earn the city recommendations and follow the Arcane University quests. Save before each assignment and ask Raminus for every promotion before taking the next task, especially before Ambush. Reload an earlier save if a promotion or guild membership is lost.

roadmap.title: Finish the Thieves Guild
roadmap.description: Fence stolen goods to open each special job. Keep saves before assignments and throughout The Ultimate Heist; reload if a failed theft or expulsion blocks progress.

roadmap.title: Finish the Dark Brotherhood
roadmap.description: Accept Lucien's invitation and finish the contracts. Bonuses are optional. Save before recruitment and each contract; reload if Lucien dies before recruitment or guild membership is lost.

roadmap.title: Resolve the Oblivion Crisis
roadmap.description: Return to the main story and finish the questline. Guilds and Shivering Isles remain available after the ending.

roadmap.title: Complete the Shivering Isles
roadmap.description: Finish the included expansion. Keep a permanent save before the Ritual of Accession choice, complete Dementia, reload for Mania, then continue to the end on either branch.

achievements.description: Escaped the Imperial Sewers, Main Quest Beginning
achievements.summary: Leave the Imperial Sewers at the end of the opening escape.

steps.text: Follow the opening escape through the prison and sewers, then leave through the final sewer gate.

achievements.description: Closed an Oblivion Gate, Main Quest
achievements.summary: Close an Oblivion Gate by removing its Sigil Stone.

steps.text: During Breaking the Siege of Kvatch, enter the gate outside Kvatch and climb the main tower.
Take the Sigil Keep Key from the Dremora guarding the captive soldier in the adjoining tower. Reach the top of the main tower and remove the @item{Sigil Stone}.

achievements.description: Located the Shrine of Dagon, Main Quest
achievements.summary: Discover where the Shrine of Dagon is hidden during The Path of Dawn.

steps.text: During The Path of Dawn, gather the four Mythic Dawn Commentaries. At the Arcane University, ask @npc{Tar-Meena} to decipher them. Wait 24 hours and ask her for the clue.
At noon, examine the glowing map on the @loc{Tomb of Prince Camarril} in Green Emperor Way.

achievements.description: Delivered Daedric Artifact, Main Quest
achievements.summary: Give Martin a Daedric artifact for Blood of the Daedra.

steps.text: For an early artifact, reach level 2 and take one Glow Dust to @loc{Azura's Shrine}. Offer it between 5–7 a.m. or 5–7 p.m.
Kill the vampires in Gutted Mine. Pull the rope beside the rock wall to reach the last vampires, then return to Azura for @item{Azura's Star}.
During Blood of the Daedra, give Martin Azura's Star or another accepted Daedric artifact. The artifact you hand over is consumed.

achievements.description: Destroyed the Great Gate, Main Quest
achievements.summary: Close the Great Gate during the defense of Bruma.

steps.text: Progress the main story through Blood of the Divines, Miscarcand and Defense of Bruma. Protect Martin until the Great Gate opens.
You have 15 minutes from entering the Great Gate to remove the Great Sigil Stone at the top of the main tower. If the war gates block you, climb a side tower and pull its lever.

achievements.description: Completed the Main Questline
achievements.summary: Finish the main story and become Champion of Cyrodiil.

steps.text: Complete Paradise and recover the Amulet of Kings from Mankar Camoran.
During Light the Dragonfires, escort Martin into the @loc{Temple of the One}. Speak with Chancellor Ocato once the final battle ends.

achievements.description: Join the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Join the Dark Brotherhood at the Murderer rank.

steps.text: Make a manual save before killing a non-hostile NPC. After the message that your killing was observed, sleep in a bed and accept Lucien Lachance's contract. Do not attack Lucien; reload the earlier save if you kill him.
Kill Rufio in the basement of the @loc{Inn of Ill Omen}, then sleep again and accept Lucien's invitation.

achievements.description: Reached Slayer rank in the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Attain the Slayer rank in the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Enter the Cheydinhal Sanctuary through the abandoned house basement. Answer the door with “Sanguine, my Brother”, then meet Ocheeva and Vicente Valtieri.
Complete A Watery Grave and Accidents Happen for Vicente, then report back. Contract bonuses are optional.

achievements.description: Reached Eliminator rank in the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Attain the Eliminator rank in the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Complete Scheduled for Execution for Vicente by killing Valen Dreth in the Imperial Prison.
For The Assassinated Man, strike Francois Motierre with the supplied Languorwine Blade while Hides-His-Heart watches. Flee without killing Hides-His-Heart and wait 24 hours outside Chorrol.
Revive Motierre with the supplied antidote in the Chapel of Stendarr undercroft. Escort him to the Grey Mare, speak to him there, then report to Vicente.

achievements.description: Reached Assassin rank in the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Attain the Assassin rank in the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Take The Lonely Wanderer from Ocheeva. Kill Faelian in Lorkmir's House in the Imperial City Elven Gardens during the day, then report to her.
Complete Ocheeva's next contracts: Bad Medicine, Whodunit? and Permanent Retirement. Return to Ocheeva after each contract.

achievements.description: Reached Silencer rank in the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Attain the Silencer rank in the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Read Orders From Lucien Lachance after Ocheeva gives you the letter. Meet Lucien at Fort Farragut; the hollow tree northwest of the ruins provides a shortcut.
Complete The Purification by killing the Cheydinhal Sanctuary members, then return to Lucien.

achievements.description: Reached Speaker rank in the Dark Brotherhood
achievements.summary: Attain the Speaker rank in the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Take the first dead-drop order from the hollow rock at Hero Hill. Complete Affairs of a Wizard, Next of Kin, Broken Vows, Final Justice, A Matter of Honor, The Coldest Sleep and A Kiss Before Dying, collecting each new order from the marked dead drop.
During Following a Lead, speak to Enilroth at the Anvil dead drop. Get the lighthouse cellar key from Ulfgar Fog-Eye and read the Traitor's Diary in the cellar.
Return to Applewatch and speak to Arquen.

achievements.description: Completed the Dark Brotherhood Questline
achievements.summary: Become Listener of the Dark Brotherhood.

steps.text: Speak to Arquen at Applewatch between midnight and 3 a.m. about the Night Mother to begin Honor Thy Mother.
Enter the crypt beneath Bravil's Lucky Old Lady statue with the Black Hand. Kill Mathieu Bellamont when he attacks, then speak to the Night Mother.

achievements.description: Joined the Arena in the Imperial City
achievements.summary: Enroll as an Arena combatant in the Imperial City.

steps.text: In the Imperial City Arena Bloodworks, tell @npc{Owyn} “I want to be a combatant”.

achievements.description: Reached Brawler rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Brawler rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 3. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Bloodletter rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Bloodletter rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 6. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Myrmidon rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Myrmidon rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 9. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Warrior rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Warrior rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 12. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Gladiator rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Gladiator rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 15. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Hero rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Hero rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 18. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Reached Champion rank in the Arena
achievements.summary: Earn the Champion rank in the Arena.

steps.text: Win the next three Arena matches, bringing your total to 21. Ask Owyn for each match during the day and return to him for payment after each victory.
steps.note: Keep a manual save before each match and keep your Arena Raiment equipped. A second disqualification ends your Arena career; reload the earlier save if this happens.

achievements.description: Completed the Arena Questline
achievements.summary: Become the Arena Grand Champion.

steps.text: After 21 regular victories, challenge @npc{Agronak gro-Malog} in the Bloodworks. Speak to @npc{Ysabel Andronicus} to arrange the title match.
Defeat Agronak, take his raiment and bring it to Ysabel.

achievements.description: Joined the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Join the Thieves Guild as a Pickpocket.

steps.text: Read a Gray Fox wanted poster, then meet @npc{Armand Christophe} at midnight in the Garden of Dareloth on the Imperial City Waterfront. Raise his disposition if he refuses to discuss the guild.
Accept May the Best Thief Win. Steal Amantius Allectus' diary from his Temple District home and deliver it to Armand. If Methredhel gets there first, steal the diary from her Waterfront house.

achievements.description: Reached Footpad rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Footpad rank in the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Sell a cumulative 50 gold of stolen goods to Ongar in Bruma. Take Untaxing the Poor from Armand at the Waterfront.
Steal the Waterfront Tax Records from the desk in the South Watch Tower captain's quarters in the Temple District. Return them to Armand.

achievements.description: Reached Bandit rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Bandit rank in the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 100 gold of fenced goods and take The Elven Maiden from Armand. Steal the Bust of Llathasa Indarys from the Chapel of Arkay undercroft in Cheydinhal.
Find Methredhel when you return to the Waterfront. Hide the bust inside Myvryna Arano's cupboard, then send Hieronymus Lex to search the house. Meet Armand at midnight to finish the job.

achievements.description: Reached Prowler rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Prowler rank in the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 200 gold of fenced goods and ask S'Krivva at Bravil's Lonely Suitor Lodge for Ahdarji's Heirloom.

Speak to Ahdarji and the prisoner Amusei in Leyawiin. Steal Ahdarji's Ring from Alessia Caro's bedside jewelry box in Castle Leyawiin while the countess is asleep. Return the ring to Ahdarji and report to S'Krivva.

achievements.description: Reached Cat Burglar rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Reach Cat Burglar within the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 300 gold of fenced goods and take Misdirection from S'Krivva. Meet Methredhel at Dynari Amnis' House in the Imperial City.

Steal Hrormir's Icestaff from the Arch-Mage's quarters and leave the supplied note in the nightstand. Give the staff to Methredhel, then watch Hieronymus Lex on the Waterfront and collect his dropped note.
Report to Methredhel. Put the staff in Ontus Vanin's chest and return to S'Krivva.

achievements.description: Reached Shadowfoot rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Shadowfoot rank in the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 400 gold of fenced goods and complete Lost Histories for S'Krivva. Get the slop-drudge job at Castle Skingrad to reach the dungeon. Use the strange candles to open the hidden passages, rescue Amusei from the Pale Lady and recover the book from the location he gives you.
Reach 500 gold of fenced goods and take Taking Care of Lex. Steal the List of Candidates from Dairihill's desk in Castle Anvil and pay the Stranger 500 gold to forge it. Collect it after 24 hours.
Stamp the forgery with the Imperial Legion Seal in the Imperial Legion Offices. Give it to Countess Millona Umbranox in Anvil, notify Lex and report to S'Krivva.

achievements.description: Reached Master Thief rank in the Thieves Guild
achievements.summary: Reach Master Thief within the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 600 gold of fenced goods and wait outside for Methredhel's message. Meet the Gray Fox at Helvius Cecia's House in Bruma for Turning a Blind Eye. Retrieve @item{Savilla's Stone} in the Temple of the Ancestor Moths and deliver the stone to him.
Reach 700 gold of fenced goods and wait outside in the Imperial City for Amusei. Meet the Gray Fox at Malintus Ancrus' House in Chorrol for Arrow of Extrication.

Use the concealed pillar passage in Fathis Aren's Castle Bravil quarters. Take the underwater side passage to his tower and retrieve the Key-Shaped Arrowhead from his laboratory chest. Bring it to the Gray Fox.

achievements.description: Completed the Thieves Guild Questline
achievements.summary: Attain the Guildmaster rank in the Thieves Guild.

steps.text: Reach 800 gold of fenced goods and wait for Amusei's message. Complete Boots of Springheel Jak for the Gray Fox by searching Jakben Imbel's Imperial City crypt and taking the boots from Jakben.

Reach 1,000 gold of fenced goods and meet the Gray Fox at Othrelos' House for The Ultimate Heist. Keep separate manual saves throughout the heist, especially before firing the Arrow of Extrication and before entering the library.

Equip the Boots of Springheel Jak. In the Imperial Palace, enter the basement from the Elder Council Chambers and activate the Glass of Time. Go to the Arboretum and use the Grate to The South East Tunnel. Continue through Beneath the Bloodworks and the Lost Catacombs.
In the large catacomb chamber, use the boots to jump onto the broken staircase on the left. Press the blocks at both ends of the balcony to open the way into the Hall of Epochs.

In the Hall of Epochs, climb to the right-hand balcony. Pick the gate's hard lock and activate the block to your left. Follow the opened passage to its final block, press it and return to the main hall.

Make a manual save and equip a bow. Stand on the central pressure plate and fire the Arrow of Extrication into the chest of the statue that turns toward you. Enter the revealed passage and sneak through the Imperial Guard Quarters to the library.

In the Elder Scrolls Library, use the switch near the blind monk and sit in the reading chair. Stay silent and wait for the Elder Scroll; take the scroll before leaving. Do not attack or speak to the monks.
steps.note: If the monks detect you before delivering the Elder Scroll, reload your save from before entering the library.

steps.text: Escape, return the Elder Scroll to the Gray Fox, then deliver the Stranger's Ring to Countess Millona Umbranox at Castle Anvil.

achievements.description: Joined the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Become a member of the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Visit the Chorrol Mages Guild and ask @npc{Teekeeus} to join. Recruiters at the other city guild halls can also admit you.

achievements.description: Reached Apprentice rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Apprentice rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Ask the guild leaders for recommendation quests in these seven cities: Chorrol, Anvil, Bravil, Bruma, Cheydinhal, Leyawiin and Skingrad. Finish each city's recommendation.
Bring the seven recommendations to @npc{Raminus Polus} at the Imperial City Arcane University.

achievements.description: Reached Journeyman rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Journeyman rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Take A Mage's Staff from Raminus Polus. At Wellspring Cave, recover the key from Zahrasha's body, clear the necromancers and take the Unfinished Staff from the Stone Chest outside the far exit.
Report to Raminus, then commission a staff from Delmar in the Chironasium. Collect the finished staff after 24 hours and ask Raminus about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Evoker rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Evoker rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Take Ulterior Motives from Raminus. Speak to Mercator Hosidus at Castle Skingrad, return after 24 hours and attend the arranged meeting outside the city at 2 a.m.
Survive the ambush, speak to Janus Hassildor and report to Raminus. Choose “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Conjurer rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Conjurer rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Take Vahtacen's Secret from Raminus, consult Irlav Jarol and meet Skaleel and Denel inside Vahtacen.

Save before attempting the pillar puzzle. Denel's chest supplies four scrolls. Cast Flare on the pillar first, followed by Snowball, then Sever Magicka, then Elevate Magicka. Stand close when using the Magicka scrolls.
Recover the Ancient Elven Helm from the opened ruins. Show it to Skaleel, report to Raminus and request “Advancement” before taking another task.

achievements.description: Reached Magician rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Magician rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Take Necromancer's Moon from Raminus. Read the book of that name in the Mystic Archives and consult Tar-Meena, Raminus and Bothiel.
Investigate Dark Fissure. Take the Handwritten Note from the Worm Anchorite just inside the cave, then report to Raminus and choose “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Warlock rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Warlock rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Take Liberation or Apprehension? through Raminus and Hannibal Traven. Search Nenyond Twyll for Mucianus Allias and discover that he has become a zombie.
steps.note: Do not kill your ally Fithragaer if his trap scene stalls. Reload a save from before entering the ruin.

steps.text: Report to Traven, then ask Raminus about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Wizard rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Gain the Wizard rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Complete Information at a Price for Hannibal Traven. Kill the vampires in Bloodcrust Cavern and show Vampire Dust to Eridor in Skingrad so the hunters leave. Report to Count Hassildor and Traven.
Wait 48 hours and take A Plot Revealed from Traven. At the ruined Bruma Mages Guild, kill Camilla Lollia and speak to J'skar. Report to Traven, then request “Advancement” from Raminus.

achievements.description: Reached Master-Wizard rank in the Mages Guild
achievements.summary: Receive the Mages Guild title of Master-Wizard.

steps.text: Before handing Traven the final artifact, make a manual save. For The Necromancer's Amulet, recover Caranya's amulet in Fort Ontus. For The Bloodworm Helm, search Irlav Jarol's body in Fort Teleman and recover the helm.
After handing in both artifacts, speak to Raminus Polus and choose “Advancement” before accepting Ambush from Traven. Confirm that the Master-Wizard achievement unlocks.
steps.note: Taking Ambush first can skip this promotion. Reload the save from before the artifact hand-in if the promotion is lost.

achievements.description: Completed the Mages Guild Questline
achievements.summary: Gain the Arch-Mage rank in the Mages Guild.

steps.text: Complete Ambush at Silorn and bring the Colossal Black Soul Gem from Falcar to Traven.
For Confront the King, take the Echo Cave Key from Bolor Savel outside Echo Cave. Defeat Mannimarco inside, then return to Raminus at the Arcane University.

achievements.description: Joined the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Become a member of the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Clear any bounty, then ask @npc{Azzan} at the Anvil Fighters Guild to join. Vilena Donton in Chorrol and Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal can also recruit you.

achievements.description: Reached Apprentice rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Apprentice rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Take A Rat Problem from Azzan in Anvil and complete the investigation for Arvena Thelas. Return to Azzan and ask about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Journeyman rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Journeyman rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Complete The Desolate Mine for Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal, delivering the weapons and clearing the goblins.

Take The Unfortunate Shopkeeper from Azzan. Meet Norbert Lelles at Lelles' Quality Merchandise in Anvil, wait inside until midnight and kill the three burglars. Report back and ask Azzan about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Swordsman rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Swordsman rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Ask Vilena Donton in Chorrol about “Duties”, then see Modryn Oreyn. Complete Unfinished Business by recovering Brenus Astis' journal from Fallen Rock Cave.
For Drunk and Disorderly, speak to Vantus Prelius at the Five Claws Lodge in Leyawiin. Give Margarte five Ectoplasm to secure work for the fighters.
steps.note: Ghosts in Rielle's crypt, northwest of Bruma, drop Ectoplasm. Use magic or a silver or enchanted weapon against them.

steps.text: Tell Vantus about the work, report to Modryn and ask about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Protector rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Protector rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Complete Amelion's Debt for Burz gro-Khash. Help Biene Amelion at Water's Edge by retrieving the requested gear or paying her 1,000 gold.
Complete Den of Thieves for Azzan. Ask Newheim the Portly at Anvil's docks about the thieves, then clear Hrota Cave. Report back and ask Azzan or Burz about “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Defender rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Defender rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Take The Master's Son from Modryn Oreyn. Accompany Viranus Donton to Nonwyll Cavern and find Galtus Previa's body.

For More Unfinished Business, find Maglir at Bravil's Lonely Suitor Lodge. Speak to Aryarie in the Bravil Mages Guild and bring her 10 Imp Galls from Robber's Glen Cave. Report to Modryn and request “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Warder rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Warder rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Meet Modryn Oreyn at his Chorrol home at midnight for Azani Blackheart. Meet him again at the Leyawiin Fighters Guild and enter Arpenia together.
In Arpenia's second room, find the bloodstained elevator trap near an Ayleid Cask. Step onto the trap, then ask Modryn about “Azani Blackheart”.
Stay with Modryn as he leads you out of Arpenia and on to Atatar. Kill Azani Blackheart and take Blackheart's Ring. Give the ring to Modryn and request “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Reached Guardian rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Guardian rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Complete The Fugitives for Burz gro-Khash by killing the four escaped prisoners in Bloodmayne Cave, west of Bravil.
Accept The Wandering Scholar from Azzan. In Brittlerock Cave, protect Elante of Alinor until she reaches the shrine. Report back and request “Advancement” from Azzan or Burz.

achievements.description: Reached Champion rank in the Fighters Guild
achievements.summary: Attain the Champion rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Complete Trolls of the Forsaken Mine for Modryn Oreyn. Retrieve A Bloody Journal from Viranus Donton's body in Forsaken Mine.
Complete The Noble's Daughter and Mystery of Harlun's Watch for Burz gro-Khash. Rescue Lady Rogbut, then investigate Swampy Cave and kill every troll in both sections.
Complete The Stone of St. Alessia for Azzan. Recover the stone from Sedor and return it to Cirroc in Bruma. Report to Azzan and request “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Completed the Fighters Guild Questline
achievements.summary: Attain the Master rank in the Fighters Guild.

steps.text: Visit Modryn Oreyn at his Chorrol home. Complete Information Gathering at Glademist Cave, then Infiltration by joining the Blackwood Company and drinking the supplied Hist Sap.
For The Hist, return to the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin. Kill its leaders and take their keys to reach the basement. Use the two Loose Pipes beside the Hist tree to break both pumps.
Report to Modryn, then speak to Vilena Donton in Chorrol and choose “Advancement”.

achievements.description: Entered the Shivering Isles
achievements.summary: Enter the Shivering Isles.

steps.text: Visit the island with the strange door in Niben Bay, east of Bravil. After the scene outside, use the door and speak to Haskill inside.
Sit in the chair, accept Haskill's offer and enter the Shivering Isles.

achievements.description: Reached Aspirant Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Aspirant.

steps.text: Complete Through the Fringe of Madness. Kill the Gatekeeper, take its keys and enter either the Mania or Dementia gate.
Visit Sheogorath in his New Sheoth palace and speak to him.

achievements.description: Reached Citizen Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Citizen.

steps.text: Complete A Better Mousetrap in Xedilian. Take Crystal Staffs from the Grummite Shamans, use them at the three Judgment Nexuses and activate the Resonator of Judgment.
Complete Baiting the Trap with Kiliban Nyrandil. Choose either trap outcome in each chamber, then defeat the Knights of Order and speak to Kiliban.

achievements.description: Reached Madman Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Madman.

steps.text: During Understanding Madness, follow Sheogorath's instructions to summon and speak to Haskill. Take The Lady of Paranoia and Addiction.
For The Lady of Paranoia, use Herdir to question Kithlan and Anya Herrick in Syl's court, then Ma'zaddha and Bisha in Crucible. Bisha reveals the secret meeting.
At midnight, overhear Ma'zaddha and Nelrene without being detected. Confront Ma'zaddha after they finish speaking, then wait 24 hours.
Search Ma'zaddha's corpse in his house and take the key. Unlock the upstairs cupboard. Take Nelrene's Ceremonial Shortsword along with Ma'zaddha's Crinkled Note.
Show the evidence to Nelrene, then confront Muurine. Tell Syl that Muurine planned the conspiracy and attend the execution in the torture chamber.
For Addiction, speak to Thadon and Wide-Eye. Eat Felldew from the Elytra outside Dunroot Burrow to enter, then retrieve the Chalice of Reversal from the Sanctum of Decadence and return it to Thadon.

achievements.description: Reached Honored Madman Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Honored Madman.

steps.text: Complete The Cold Flame of Agnon. At Cylarne, help either the Golden Saints or Dark Seducers win, then step into the Flame of Agnon.
Carry the flame back to New Sheoth. At the Sacellum Arden-Sul, light either altar. Keep a permanent manual save before the upcoming Ritual of Accession decision.

achievements.description: Reached Duke of Dementia Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Become Duke of Dementia through the Ritual of Dementia.

steps.text: Keep a permanent manual save from before the Ritual of Accession choice. Learn both rituals from Arctus and Dervenin, then tell Sheogorath “I choose Syl, Duchess of Dementia”.

In the House of Dementia, persuade Anya Herrick and Kithlan to help you reach Syl. Search her private chambers; the body there is a decoy. Use the Sheogorath bust in the Private Gardens to open the passage to Xirethard.
Find and kill Syl in Xirethard, take her heart and burn it on the Sacellum Arden-Sul altar. Speak to Sheogorath to receive the title.
Once the achievement unlocks, reload the save from before the choice and complete the Mania ritual for the other Duke achievement.

achievements.description: Reached Duke of Mania Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Become Duke of Mania through the Ritual of Mania.

steps.text: Load or keep the permanent save from before the Ritual of Accession choice. Learn both rituals from Arctus and Dervenin, then tell Sheogorath “I choose Thadon, Duke of Mania”.
Ask Wide-Eye in the House of Mania about Thadon's routine. Follow her to the hidden Greenmote Silo entrance around noon and steal two doses of Greenmote.
Sneak into the Duke's Quarters and put Greenmote in both Thadon's food and wine. Wait in the throne room until 8 p.m., let him die and collect his blood.
Put the blood on the Sacellum Arden-Sul altar and speak to Sheogorath. If you still need the Dementia achievement, reload the save from before the choice and complete that ritual.

achievements.description: Reached Regent Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.sortReason: Continue after the Mania branch in the recommended Dementia-save-reload-Mania route; either Duke title opens this quest in-game.
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Regent.

guide.context: Retaking the Fringe opens after you become Duke of either Mania or Dementia. The recommended save-and-reload route finishes Mania last.

steps.text: Complete Retaking the Fringe. Fight alongside the guards, enter Xeddefen and disable its obelisk with three Hearts of Order taken from the knights. Escape and report to Sheogorath.
For Rebuilding the Gatekeeper, meet Relmyna Verenim at Xaselm. Collect Dermis Membrane, Osseous Marrow, Essence of Breath and Blood Liqueur from the Gardens of Flesh and Bone.
Return to Relmyna, select the Gatekeeper's body parts and meet her for the ritual. Put the ingredients into the cistern when she asks, then report to Sheogorath.

achievements.description: Reached Defender of the Realm Rank in the Court of Madness
achievements.summary: Receive the Court of Madness title of Defender of the Realm.

steps.text: Complete The Helpless Army at the fortress named by the messenger. Free the trapped commander using the chime, then reach the Font of Rebirth.
Ring the chimes around the wellspring to break its crystal cover. Speak to the commander after restoring the wellspring.

achievements.description: Stopped the Greymarch
achievements.summary: Defeat Jyggalag and end the Greymarch.

steps.text: For Symbols of Office, consult Dyus in Knifepoint Hollow about the Staff of Sheogorath. In Milchar, defeat your reflection and collect a branch at the Tree of Shades. In the Howling Halls, kill Ciirta and collect her eye. Give Dyus the branch and eye.

During The Roots of Madness, enter the Fountainhead and clear the Priests of Order from both pools. Use Gnarl Chrysalises to open root-covered doors, then return to the palace font to finish the staff.
During The End of Order, use three Hearts of Order on each active obelisk outside the palace. Defeat Jyggalag when he appears.
